issues.title: Some orders never show up in the list
issues.body: When I page through `python3 -m orderdesk list`, order 3 is missing. All five orders should be listed.

issues.title: Revenue is too low
issues.body: `python3 -m orderdesk revenue` prints 83, but the five orders add up to 113.

issues.title: Average order value is rounded down to a whole number
issues.body: `python3 -m orderdesk average` prints 22. The orders average 22.6.

issues.title: since leaves out orders placed at the given time
issues.body: `python3 -m orderdesk since 105` should list orders 2, 3, 4 and 5, since 2 and 3 were placed at 105. It lists only 4 and 5.
